newsitem.title: USA: Apple names NEC exec to run PowerBook unit.
newsitem.headline: Apple names NEC exec to run PowerBook unit.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Monday it had named Dale Fuller as vice president and general manager of the company's PowerBook portable computer unit, effective September 30.
Fuller was formerly vice president of Laptop Computer Products at NEC Corp's NEC Technologies unit.
Apple said Fuller will be responsible for the design, development, and marketing of PowerBook products, with full profit and loss responsibility for the division.
The company said Fuller will report to Fred Forsyth, senior vice president of the Macintosh Products Group.
"Dale is a seasoned industry executive with direct experience in successfully managing and growing a portable computer business," said Forsyth.
"Under his watch at NEC, the laptop division gained market share, broadened its product line, and improved profitability."

Fuller joins Apple with more than 16 years of broad industry experience, including positions at Apple, Canon Inc, Motorola Inc, and Texas Instruments Inc. He spent four years at Apple from 1987 to 1991 in the Business Development Group.
